subject: Click & Drop - Payment confirmation
body_content:
Your payment has been successfully processed
Thank you for your order

You have made a payment of £4.65 to the Royal Mail Group Ltd.

You have confirmed that you are not sending any item which is prohibited or restricted in the UK or overseas. If you are sending an item outside the UK, please make sure you have attached the appropriate completed customs declaration form to your package.

A summary of your purchase is set out below:


 


Order number 1250


Recipient: Brian Russel, Alexander Pollock Ltd, Hospital Road, Scotland, EH41 3PD, United Kingdom
Postage service: Royal Mail Tracked 24
Total Postage cost: £4.65
Net Amount: £3.88
VAT: £0.77

Item must be posted by: 02/10/2026

 

Next Steps

Option 1: Drop off your items (If you haven't arranged a collection)

  • Postboxes and Parcel Postboxes (Royal Mail items only) - Print your label and drop off at a Postbox for small items that fit through a letterbox, or a Parcel Postbox for small parcels - you can even get proof of posting via the Royal Mail App.

  • Lockers (Royal Mail items only) - Print your label, or use the QR code above to print and drop off at one of our Lockers and get proof of posting emailed to you.

  • Royal Mail Shops (Royal Mail items only) - Print your label, or use the QR code above to print and drop off at a Royal Mail Shop.

  • Post Office branches (accept both Royal Mail & Parcelforce items*) - Print your label or, use the QR code above (if shown) and drop off at a Post Office branch.
    * Excluding express48large.

  • Parcelforce Depot (Parcelforce items only) - Print your label and drop off at a Parcelforce Depot.
Parcelforce items can be dropped off at Post Office branches or Parcelforce Depots.

Not all services are eligible for QR code printing. This includes Parcelforce services, Tracked 24/48 Age Verification services and international services with an item value greater than £270. Find more information here.

Option 2: If you have arranged a collection

  • Make sure your item is packaged securely and that you have attached the label to your item before your scheduled collection time.

  • Your item(s) will be collected by us on the selected collection day.

  • If you've selected our Bring My Label option then we will bring your labels with us when we come to collect your item(s).

And finally, make sure you've posted your item by the date shown on the label.

If you have purchased a Royal Mail Tracked service, please note the price includes VAT at the standard rate.

Your purchase is subject to our Terms & Conditions which you have accepted: You have a right to cancel and request a refund of the purchase you have made as long as the request is submitted within 14 calendar days, and that you have not already presented the item into a Royal Mail Group network (please see the Click & Drop Terms & Conditions for further information). Inappropriate or fraudulent claims for refunds will not be honoured. Royal Mail Group reserves its right to prosecute fraudulent activity relating to the Click & Drop Online Postage channel.

If you have any queries about payments, please contact us. If you would like to apply for a refund, please refer to our applying for a refund help article.

Please note that refunds are only valid for items that haven't entered the Royal Mail Network. Refunds will be processed once the label has expired and take five days before you will see it in the account of the original method of payment. This email also acts as a Simplified VAT Receipt that is accepted by HMRC.

Thank you,

The Royal Mail Team
